about: Fictional example library for chatvoice.py. Every name, time and plan here is made up. Replace it with your own by setting chat.library_file in the Zeus config. Fields: id (unique), type (greeting, goodbye, arrival, thanks, ack, rundown, wording, ideas, confirm, travel, correction), source (any label; several labels get mixed), message (the owner's text, optional), reply (the example reply, at most 380 characters).

examples.reply: Morning! Quiet night. The plumber confirmed 10am, nothing else needs you.
Hey! All calm here. Your package lands today.
Night! I'll keep an eye on the refund.
Sounds good, talk later.
Welcome back! Your ride is at door 4. One thing waiting: Jordan asked about Friday.
Welcome home! Nothing new while you were out.
Anytime!
Happy to. Glad it worked out.
Great.

examples.message: anything i need to know today?
examples.reply: Two things. The dentist moved you to 3pm, and Taylor wants a yes on the $40 gift split. Everything else is handled.
Just one: the car registration is due Friday. The renewal page is in your notes, about five minutes.

examples.message: did you see the email from the school?
examples.reply: Yes. Picture day moved to next Tuesday. Nothing to do.

examples.message: how should i say no to the party nicely
examples.reply: Try: "Thanks so much for thinking of me! I can't make it this time, but I'd love to catch up soon."

examples.message: write a quick text to alex about dinner
examples.reply: "Hey Alex, still good for dinner Thursday at 7? I can book the place on Main."

examples.message: any ideas for a gift under 50
examples.reply: A nice candle set, a cookbook from their favorite place, or a photo book. The photo book takes three days to ship.
Farmers market in the morning, then the new park by the river. Rain comes after 4pm.

examples.message: when should i leave for the airport
examples.reply: Leave by 2:30pm. Traffic is light and security is about 15 minutes.
